title: cloud: the AI tool name action_<bare> carries no object, so two packages' same-named object-bound actions collide (bare-name phase 3, item 14 condition)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② execution of a maintainer ruling. This is item 14 of the bare-name phase 3 evaluation (#30806). The maintainer exempted object-bound actions and hooks from the namespace-prefix rule, with the condition that this one measured clash is fixed on the cloud side. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the `domain:cloud` lane (repo `cloud`). Parked per the 2026-10-26 ruling for cloud-side cards filed from this repo.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `action_ tool name object`, `AI tool name action bare` → #30806 only.
reach: every hosted environment whose AI tool list includes two packages' object-bound actions that share a short name on different objects.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p2, self-graded by the server seat (Ruling-ref: 「定级你可以自己决定」). It is the condition attached to a maintainer exemption.

## 维护者速读

按裁决（#30806 第 14 项，A「免加」），对象级动作与钩子不加命名空间前缀，靠前缀对象区分（运行时键 objectName:name）。唯一测到的冲突在云端：AI 工具名 `action_<裁名>` 不带对象名，两个包在不同对象上的同名动作会撞名。请在云端把对象名放进工具名。

## What is wrong (measured by the #30806 plan review, cloud side, read not run here)

- Cloud's AI tool name for an action is `action_` plus the bare action name. Two object-bound actions with the same short name on different objects (for example `convert_lead` on two packages' objects) produce one tool name.

## Expected

- The tool name carries the object, for example `action_OBJECT_NAME` or an equivalent stable spelling. Two same-named object-bound actions on different objects produce two tools.
- Pins: two packages, one short action name on two objects, two distinct tools. CONTROL: a top-level action keeps its tool name, or the change of name is named in the changelog.
